turns.final_message:
I fixed it, and all 5 tests now pass.

You didn't say what was wrong, so I ran the tests. `test_wrap_exact_width` was failing. `wrap("aaa bbb ccc", 7)` returned `['aaa', 'bbb', 'ccc']` instead of `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`.

The cause was an off-by-one in `src/wrap.py`. The check `len(cur) + extra > width - 1` started a new line one character too early, so a line that exactly filled `width` got split. I changed it to `> width`.

If the problem you meant was something else, tell me what you were seeing and I'll look again.

I fixed one more bug. The 5 tests still pass.

It now returns `['abcdefghij', 'kl']`. I changed the line-break check in `src/wrap.py` to `if cur and len(cur) + extra > width:`.

Words longer than `width` stay on their own line and are not split. If you want them broken at `width`, say so and I'll add that.

I'm still guessing at what you saw. If it's something else, give me an input and the output you expected and I'll fix that.
